changeSet.comment: Whether the request that produced this auth event reached its workspace on instance-admin authority rather than membership. DEFAULT false backfills existing rows, which means false reads as "not known to be elevated" for anything written before this column, never as "known to be a member".

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The same bit on the configuration trail, resolved for the row's own workspace, so the two audit viewers cannot disagree about whether one action was performed under elevation.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_auth_event_event_type' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%WORKSPACE_ELEVATION%'

changeSet.comment: Admit WORKSPACE_ELEVATION on auth_event: the marker written when an instance admin reaches a workspace they are not a member of. The list is the shipped vocabulary plus that one value, so the ADD validates every existing row in one pass under a momentary ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, no rewrite. The change set is not reversible, because narrowing the CHECK back would reject a WORKSPACE_ELEVATION row already in the ledger and an append-only trail may not delete one to make room. DROP IF EXISTS so an instance whose constraint was already removed by hand migrates instead of halting the whole chain.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE auth_event DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_auth_event_event_type; ALTER TABLE auth_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ( 'LOGIN', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'TOKEN_REFRESH', 'JWT_REVOKED', 'IDENTITY_LINKED', 'IDENTITY_UNLINKED', 'IMPERSONATION_BEGIN', 'IMPERSONATION_END', 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', 'EXPORT_REQUESTED', 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_CONSENT_REVOKED', 'WORKSPACE_ELEVATION', 'LLM_CONNECTION_CREATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_UPDATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_CREATED', 'LLM_MODEL_UPDATED', 'LLM_MODEL_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_PRICE_CHANGED', 'LLM_MODEL_SHARING_CHANGED', 'LLM_SETTINGS_CHANGED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_CREATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_UPDATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_DELETED', 'SILENT_MODE_CHANGED' ));
